critical_code_review_comments: Fixed: services/ai_chat_service.py::stream_text — when a text part between kn-* blocks was pure whitespace (e.g. '\n\n' separator), the `re.findall(r'\s*\S+', part) or [part]` fallback yielded the whitespace once and the trailing-whitespace tail branch yielded it again, so concat(deltas) had duplicated blank lines vs done.text. rca of the issue: stream_text bug: `re.findall(r'\s*\S+', part) or [part]` — for a pure-whitespace `part` (frequent between two kn-* code blocks), findall returned [] and the `or [part]` fallback yielded the whole whitespace once, but the subsequent `if part[-1:].isspace()` branch also yielded `part[len(part.rstrip()):]` which equals the full part (since rstrip='' → len=0), duplicating the separator. Reproduction: any mock/template streamed answer where two kn-* blocks are separated by '\n\n'; assert ''.join(delta.text for delta in stream) == done.text would fail. Fix: split the fallback branch — if no words found, emit `part` once and continue; otherwise emit words + trailing whitespace as before. Regression: `tests/test_tanya_kn_streaming_costpage.py::test_stream_free_question_word_by_word` and `test_stream_template_routed_question` now pass concat==done.text assertions.
